fields.home_care: Aap rest lekar aur baahar fluid drink karne should. Agar aapko bhari ho jayenge to doctor se call karen.
fields.what_doctor_said: Doctor aapko examine kiya aur aapki symptoms infection se ho sakte hain, dekho agar aapki symptoms bhari ho jayen ya nahi mile jaye to aap doctor se baat karenge.
fields.why_you_came: Aap ne fever, vomiting aur stomach pain se aaye the.
